exact_missing_items: Acceptance/evidence/coverage schemas cannot express work-package/seam/promotion/account/lane identity — these schema families must be extended
Base provider envelope/spec schemas omit node/attempt/safe-point fields — these must be added to make provider envelopes node-aware
Contamination is a major gap: there is no shared event family, state object, or vocabulary for contamination classification, restore-before-reuse, or lane quarantine semantics

GPT-5.3-Codex: contamination policy is a vocabulary gap — safe-point language exists in newer addenda but contamination classification, restore-before-reuse, and lane quarantine semantics are mostly absent
Not yet defined: how node retry memory, attempt handoff artifacts, reusable learning records, and worker handoff packets map into the seglog/redb/Tantivy stack — this gap must be resolved
Plans/Multi-Account.md is missing 'Effective Identity' coverage for storage and evidence — the effective account identity must be stored and tracked with run artifacts

Schemas stop at node-level modeling — acceptance/evidence/coverage/GUI automation/test schemas cannot represent work package, feature seam, lane, promotion class, contamination state, resolution thread, or effective account identity; these must all be added
Storage/event keys still lack: project_id, attempt_id, package_id, seam_id, lane_id, worktree_id, safe_point_id, promotion_class, requested/effective account fields — all must be added
safe-point vs restore-point vs rollback vocabulary is NOT normalized across runtime, policy, interview, and worktree docs — one canonical vocabulary must be chosen
startup recovery remains split across policy, executor, and storage docs with no single owner deciding how interrupted attempts become stale_historical vs rehydrated vs startup_recovered
give startup recovery, backoff, counter ceilings, DAE/jail lifecycle, account-switch strategy invalidation, and wizard blocked-escalation semantics explicit homes in the policy/run-mode/gate docs
